line_evidence.text: A4.3.9 Describe how CNNs are designed to adaptively learn spatial hierarchies of features in images.
• Convolutional neural network (CNN) basic architecture: input layer, convolutional layers, activation
functions, pooling layers, fully connected layers, output layer
• The effect of the number of layers, kernel size and stride, activation function selection, and the loss
function on how CNNs process input data and classify images
